title: IHC Validation of TP53 Expression in Human Glioma Using Monoclonal Antibody
author: Rosie Liu
materials: Detection Reagents HRP-labeled Goat anti-rabbit IgG polymer 0.05% DAB (3,3'-Diaminobenzidine) chromogenic solution (prepare fresh and protect from light) Hematoxylin counterstain Graded ethanol series (60%, 75%, 85%, 95%, 100%) Xylene Neutral mounting medium

Detection Reagents HRP-labeled Goat anti-rabbit IgG polymer 0.05% DAB (3,3'-Diaminobenzidine) chromogenic solution (prepare fresh and protect from light) Hematoxylin counterstain Graded ethanol series (60%, 75%, 85%, 95%, 100%) Xylene Neutral mounting medium

steps.title: Fix tissue in formalin
steps.instruction: Place fresh human glioma tissue in 10 % neutral buffered formalin and incubate at room temperature for 24–48 hours.

steps.title: Dehydrate and clear tissue
steps.instruction: Process tissues through graded ethanol (60 %, 75 %, 85 %, 95 %, 100 % I, 100 % II) for 5 minutes each, then clear in xylene (two changes, 15 minutes each).

steps.title: Paraffin infiltration and embedding
steps.instruction: Infiltrate cleared tissues with molten paraffin wax (three changes, 30 minutes each at 60 °C) and embed in paraffin blocks.

steps.title: Cut sections
steps.instruction: Section paraffin blocks at 4–5 µm thickness using a microtome and collect serial sections.

steps.title: Coat slides with APES
steps.instruction: Prepare 2 % APES‑acetone solution (6 mL APES + 300 mL acetone, mix thoroughly) and pre‑coat glass slides with this solution.

steps.title: Float and mount sections
steps.instruction: Float sections on a 45 °C water bath, then carefully mount onto the APES‑coated slides.

steps.title: Dry and bake slides
steps.instruction: Dry slides at 37 °C overnight, then bake at 60 °C for 1 hour to ensure complete adhesion.

steps.title: Dewax and rehydrate slides
steps.instruction: Immerse slides in xylene for ≥60 minutes, then sequentially in 100 % ethanol I (5 min), 100 % ethanol II (5 min), 95 % ethanol (5 min), 85 % ethanol (5 min), 75 % ethanol (5 min), and 60 % ethanol (5 min). Rinse three times with ddH₂O, 5 minutes each.

steps.title: Antigen retrieval
steps.instruction: Place hydrated slides in a pressure cooker containing pre‑heated citric‑acid/sodium‑citrate buffer (pH 6.0). Heat at 1000 W until the pressure valve rises, maintain high pressure for 2–3 minutes, then turn off heat and allow natural cooling (20–30 minutes). Remove slides and rinse three times with 1× PBS, 5 minutes each.

steps.title: Block non‑specific binding
steps.instruction: Cover sections with 10 % normal goat serum blocking solution, incubate at room temperature for 30 minutes in a humidified chamber; do not rinse, gently tap off excess solution.

steps.title: Block endogenous peroxidase
steps.instruction: Incubate slides with 3 % H₂O₂ solution at room temperature for 10 minutes, then rinse three times with 1× PBS, 5 minutes each.

steps.title: Primary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Apply diluted TP53 primary antibody (1:100 in 1 % BSA‑PBS) to cover the tissue sections, incubate overnight at 4 °C in a humidified chamber. The next day, equilibrate slides at room temperature for 30 minutes, then rinse three times with PBST, 5 minutes each.

steps.title: Secondary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Apply HRP‑labeled goat anti‑rabbit IgG polymer to cover the tissue sections, incubate at room temperature for 30 minutes in a humidified chamber. Rinse three times with PBST, 5 minutes each.

steps.title: Counterstain nuclei
steps.instruction: Stain nuclei with hematoxylin for 3–5 minutes, then rinse in running tap water for 10 minutes to blue the nuclei.

steps.title: Develop DAB chromogen
steps.instruction: Cover sections with freshly prepared 0.05 % DAB solution, monitor color development under a microscope for 1–5 minutes until desired intensity is reached, then terminate the reaction by immersing slides in CSB‑RA825742A0HU.

steps.title: Final drying and mounting
steps.instruction: Bake slides at 60 °C until completely dry, mount with neutral balsam, and cover with a coverslip.

steps.title: Image stained slides
steps.instruction: Observe the stained slides under a bright‑field microscope and capture representative images.
